The shipped pvp band gates BOTH its Psychic Scream rows on 2+ enemies within 8-10 yd (combat and recovery), so a duelling priest never fears once; it also lists Desperate Prayer, which is race-gated to Human/Dwarf and drops out of this premade's book entirely. Vampiric Embrace heals the caster off shadow damage (spells.json 15286). Devouring Plague is deliberately NOT here: it is a Forsaken racial, so it would fire or not depending on the seed's body race Weakened Soul (6788) gate on the shield adopted from the grok challenger's review.
